move: five blurred screen-blend gradient orbs weave on Lissajous curves and pulse
how: Five 520px radial-gradient orbs with mix-blend-mode screen and filter blur(28px) on near-black, each following a Lissajous curve with integer frequencies 1 to 3 and radii 260 to 320 by 150 to 230, scaling 0.9 to 1.3 on a two-pulse sine, all set from t via gsap.set so t=D equals t=0. A fractal-noise SVG grain overlay at 14% and a static caption sit on top.
adapt: Change the five gradient colour pairs, the orb size and the caption; keep integer Lissajous frequencies so the loop closes.
port: mount(el, shot) appends the .o orbs, the grain SVG (unique filter id) and caption; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one {t:0->D, ease:none} tween whose onUpdate runs the seek(t) gsap.set calls. Scope querySelectorAll('.o') to el.
caveats: filter: blur(28px) on five 520px orbs with screen blend plus a feTurbulence overlay is heavy
